items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: We made one in New York. That was with a singer, Martin Donnelly.

ctx.x: He made millions for Joe. We knew he made millions for Joe Glazer.

When Joe Glazer came with Louis, he was a big show. He had nothing. Louis just had the trumpet. Joe Glazer had that one suit. I remember that. He was hustling. He started booking the band. He had a little piece. Mills had an office. Joe Glazer had a little corner where he used to get the ring. The next year, Joe Glazer had an office in Radio City. One office. The following year, he had the whole floor. Then he was. Everybody singing. Mills had an office. Joe Grady had a little corner where he used to get the…
